# TCG086: Why Training AI to Have a Self Makes Governance Harder

Podcast: Download (169.9MB) | Embed

William Collins

Eyvonne Sharp

John Capobianco returns to the show to discuss the latest developments in Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic infrastructure. John and host William Collins weigh in on the ongoing debate on AI consciousness, constitutional guardrails, and model welfare policies. They also look at emerging TypeSafe System One models and the practical realities of deploying autonomous agents in production.
